title: Stamp 3: ETA, Catalonia, and Regional Tensions
welcome_lead: Stamp regional questions: ETA's end and Catalan independence.
meta_desc: A-Level Spanish adventure on ETA's disbandment and the Catalan independence question.

concepts.def: Euskadi Ta Askatasuna; Basque separatist group that disbanded in 2018.
State of autonomies; system of 17 autonomous communities with devolved powers.
Catalonia; autonomous community with strong identity and independence movement.
Catalan independence referendum of 1 October 2017, declared illegal by the Constitutional Court.
Article 155 of the Constitution allowing the central state to intervene in an autonomous community.

walkthroughs.body_html: Founded in 1959 under Franco, ETA killed over 800 people in its independence campaign. After a 2011 ceasefire and 2017 disarmament, ETA formally dissolved in May 2018.
On 1 October 2017, Catalan authorities held a referendum without legal authorisation. The central government invoked Article 155, dismissing the Generalitat. Leaders fled abroad or faced trial.
The 17 autonomous communities have parliaments and presidents. Catalonia, the Basque Country, and Galicia have special linguistic and fiscal arrangements rooted in historical identity.
